cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Good morning and thank you for coming here today.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: I'd like to bring you up to date with changes in the school that will affect your

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: children.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: As you know, the school buildings date from various times: some from the 1970s, some from

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: the last five years, and of course Dartfield House is over a century old.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: It was commissioned by a businessman.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Neville Richards, and intended as his family home, but he died before it was completed.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: His heir chose to sell it to the local council, who turned it into offices.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: A later plan to convert it into a tourist information centre didn't come about, through

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: lack of money, and instead it formed the nucleus of this school when it opened 40 years

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: ago.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: The school has grown as the local population has increased, and I can now give you some

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: news about the lower school site, which is separated from the main site by a road.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Planning permission has been granted for development of both sites.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: The lower school will move to new buildings that will be constructed on the main site.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Developers will construct houses on the existing lower school site.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Work on the new school buildings should start within the next few months.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: A more imminent change concerns the catering facilities and the canteen.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: The canteen is always very busy throughout the lunch period – in fact it's often full to

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: capacity, because a lot of our pupils like the food that's on offer there.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: But there's only one serving point, so most pupils have to wait a considerable time to be

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: served.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: This is obviously unsatisfactory, as they may have hardly finished their lunch before

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: afternoon lessons start.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: So we've had a new Food Hall built, and this will come into use next week.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: It'll have several serving areas, and I'll give you more details about those in a minute,

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: but one thing we ask you to do, to help in the smooth running of the Food Hall, is to

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: discuss with your children each morning which type of food they want to eat that day, so

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: they can go straight to the relevant serving point.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: There won't be any junk food – everything on offer will be healthy – and there's no

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: change to the current system of paying for lunches by topping up your child's electronic

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: payment card online.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: You may be wondering what will happen to the old canteen.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: We'll still have tables and chairs in there, and pupils can eat food from the Food Hall

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: or lunch they've brought from home.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Eventually we may use part of the canteen for storage, but first we'll see how many

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: pupils go in there at lunchtime.
